_help: Casting sheet for audio/gen_voices.py. Paste an ElevenLabs library voice ID (or its voice-library link) into voice_id. Voice IDs are not secrets; the API key goes in .env. Library voices only, no clones of real people. stability: null uses the voice's own saved setting; for the v3 model 0.0 is creative, 0.5 natural, 1.0 robust (closest to the voice's sample). A line can override it in lines.csv. tempo speeds a speaker up without changing pitch and max_pause (seconds) shortens long pauses; both are applied after generation, so changing them costs no credits for takes that are still raw.

clown.name: Clown
clown.brief: Clown, the Court Jester. Narrates every scene (about 40% of all lines). Quick, playful and a little pompous, like a costume drama narrated by someone who's had one glass of wine. Never slow, never mean to the players.

hamlet.name: Hamlet
hamlet.brief: Prince Hamlet. Earnest young royal, flustered but game, with a dry joke under pressure ('An extremely purple one').

miranda.name: Miranda
miranda.brief: Princess Miranda. Soft, warm and sure of herself; robust stability keeps her close to the voice sample, and a light speed-up trims her long pauses. Passionate only when she refuses a marriage chosen for her (E02_P3, which overrides stability to 0.5). Cheers Hamlet on and scolds her father during the fights.

prospero.name: Prospero
prospero.brief: Duke Prospero, Miranda's father. Older, stern, proud and quick to judge; softens in the reconciliation ending. One voice for both moods: nice after the Giant is beaten (C03, E01), mad after it wins (C04); the mood comes from the audio tags.

tinman.name: Lord Tinman
tinman.brief: Lord Tinman, the heartless rival (tinman flies grow no heart). Impeccably polite, cool and smug; insults delivered like compliments.

cheapdate.name: Sir Cheapdate
cheapdate.brief: Sir Cheapdate, the tipsy rival (cheapdate flies get drunk on less alcohol). Jolly, hiccuping, cheerfully aware of his own 'extensive, regrettable research'.

rutabaga.name: Count Rutabaga
rutabaga.brief: Count Rutabaga, the forgetful rival (rutabaga flies are bad at learning and memory). Nervous, scattered and friendly; forgets whom he's courting and loses insults halfway through.
